title: Spy satellite, 1966 (KH-7 GAMBIT)
note: KH-7 GAMBIT surveillance camera, declassified 2002. About 0.6–1.2 m detail. Black and white film scan.

title: Spy satellite, July 1972 (KH-9 HEXAGON)
note: KH-9 HEXAGON panoramic camera (aft), declassified 2011. About 0.6–1.2 m detail. Black and white film scan.

title: Spy satellite, November 1972 (KH-9 HEXAGON)
note: KH-9 HEXAGON panoramic camera (forward), declassified 2011. About 0.6–1.2 m detail. Black and white film scan.

title: Spy satellite, 1976, north (KH-9 HEXAGON)
note: KH-9 HEXAGON panoramic camera, declassified 2011. Covers the old city and Mitiga; the frame after it covers Abu Salim.

title: Spy satellite, 1976, south (KH-9 HEXAGON)
note: KH-9 HEXAGON panoramic camera, declassified 2011. Covers Abu Salim and Ain Zara; the frame before it covers the old city.

title: Spy satellite, 1983 (KH-9 HEXAGON)
note: KH-9 HEXAGON panoramic camera (aft), declassified 2011. Taken a year before Abu Salim prison was finished.
